specs.source_title: Bambu ASA CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701B51
specs.locator: p.4, 3 - Composition / Information on Ingredients › Component/Substance (rows 1-2)
specs.test_condition: Composition by weight (SDS section 3): ASA 78-89 % (CAS 71512-90-8), carbon fiber 5-10 % (CAS 7440-44-0), additive 6-12 %
specs.note: The SDS is the manufacturer's own (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd., product name "Bambu ASA CF", model "B51-xx"). In its layout the first name wraps ("Acrylonitrile-styrene-acr" / "ylate (ASA)"); the quote joins the lines and the two rows. The TDS Composition cell (p.2, Other Physical and Chemical Properties) reads only "acrylonitrile - styrene - acrylate" and names no carbon fiber; its Basic Info (p.1) says "adding carbon fiber for increased stiffness". The value names both, in the form the class uses for CF filaments ("PETG, carbon fiber", "Polylactic acid, carbon fiber").

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: ASA-CF
Bambu ASA CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701B51
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters
ASA CF / PAHT CF Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 30 ± 4 MPa, elongation 4.4 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 1350 ± 120 MPa, bending strength 33 ± 3 MPa, impact 9.4 ± 0.6 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS internal inconsistency kept for review: the Specimen Printing Conditions table (p.3) gives nozzle 220 °C, bed 35 °C, 200 mm/s, 100% infill, while the footnote under it says the specimens were printed at nozzle 275 °C, bed 90 °C, 200 mm/s, 100% infill. Both are recorded in the mechanical test_condition; neither is stored as a value. The same footnote gives the annealing advice for "Bambu ASA" (80 to 90 °C, 6 to 12 hours).

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 4200 ± 270 MPa, Z 2290 ± 260 MPa), melt index (1.74 ± 0.3 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), heat deflection temperature 110 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.33% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70 °), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), spool material (PC+ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability, not a filament print setting. The ASA-CF suggested maximum volumetric flow rate (18 mm³/s, ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki 5.1) is not written to motion.max_flow for the same reason.

material.spool_type is not curated: the store page names no spool type for this filament, and the TDS gives the spool material (PC+ABS) and size, not a spool type; the only Spool option value is "Filament with spool".

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu ASA CF", model "B51-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 carbon-fiber handling warning (gloves when loading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreement kept for review: AMS HT drying for ASA-CF is 85 °C, 12h in the ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki (2.1) and 80 °C, 8 h in the drying wiki (Appendix I). No drying.* value depends on it (the stored drying values are the TDS blast-drying-oven row, which all three sources agree on).

Marketing prose proves no number: "67% more stiffness compared to standard ASA", "Superior Outdoor Durability", "Optimized for Large Models" and the warping specimen line "*Specimen Test: Model size (L*W*H): 220*100*90 mm³ (the XY direction)" are not stored as values; the "Parameters Comparison" block on the store page carries no text.

The store page recommends an external spool holder ("External Spool Holder Recommended", Cautions for Use › bullet 1; the ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki agrees). It is a recommendation, not a requirement, and names no product, so it is not written as a relation.
No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Black (46101)" has no published hex.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/a7676855216f4ea2b41e625c8b5a8cac/Bambu_ASA-CF_RoHS.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.

The ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki links its own TDS and MSDS copies for ASA-CF (wiki.bambulab.com/filament-acc/asacf-pahtcf/bambus_asa-cf_technical_data_sheet.pdf and bambu_asa-cf_msds.pdf); they were not cached and not read. The store-linked TDS V1.0 and SDS SDS20260701B51 were read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki and the store FAQ say the filament is not food-contact grade and warn of hard microscopic splinters and of styrene released at printing temperatures; no registry key holds these.
